skill.name: debugger
skill.description: Diagnoses software bugs through structured hypotheses, temporary logging, targeted fixes, regression checks, and optional Playwright MCP browser evidence.
skill.summary: Trace, fix, verify, and clean up software defects with an evidence-driven workflow.
skill.author: cubha

security_audit.summary: Two of 38 static findings are confirmed because the workflow runs project-controlled verification scripts that may execute arbitrary repository code. The remaining static findings are Markdown, safe examples, or explicit prohibitions. A separate medium-risk finding covers direct source edits and marker-based deletion.

remediation.issue: Project-controlled verification scripts can execute arbitrary code.
remediation.suggestion: Inspect script definitions and obtain user confirmation before running verify.sh, package scripts, builds, or tests.

remediation.issue: Marker-based cleanup changes source files and could remove an unintended adjacent line.
remediation.suggestion: Create a diff checkpoint, verify each marker pair, and show the cleanup diff before accepting changes.

semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions explicitly require direct log insertion and pair-based deletion. The source mutation is intentional, while the unintended-deletion risk depends on marker integrity.

content.value_statement: Intermittent bugs are difficult to isolate when evidence is incomplete. This skill structures hypotheses, captures diagnostic evidence, applies focused fixes, and verifies regressions.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes error messages, reproduction conditions, and related source files.
Ranks up to five evidence-based root cause hypotheses.
Adds marked temporary logs for JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, and Kotlin.
Uses Playwright MCP to collect browser console, network, screenshot, and DOM evidence.
Applies scoped fixes and checks callers, contracts, and shared state.
Runs available regression checks and removes inserted diagnostic logs.
limitations: Default mode requires the user to run the application and return diagnostic output.
Browser mode requires a connected Playwright MCP server, a web project, a URL, and a reproduction scenario.
Temporary log formats are defined only for JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, and Kotlin.
The workflow stops after bounded retries when available evidence cannot identify the cause.

use_cases.title: Trace an Application Error
use_cases.description: Analyze a stack trace, add focused diagnostics, identify the failing path, and verify the fix.

use_cases.title: Reproduce a Browser Defect
use_cases.description: Use Playwright evidence to reproduce a web issue and compare behavior before and after a fix.

use_cases.title: Repair a Cross-Module Regression
use_cases.description: Check callers, data contracts, and shared state before applying a durable correction.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose an Error
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose this error: [paste error]. Identify likely causes, inspect relevant files, and tell me what evidence you need before changing code.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner diagnosis from an error message or stack trace

prompt_templates.title: Instrument an Intermittent Failure
prompt_templates.prompt: Debug this intermittent failure in [feature]. Add temporary marked logs at the strongest hypotheses, then wait for my results before fixing anything.
prompt_templates.scenario: Evidence collection when the bug is not immediately reproducible

prompt_templates.title: Debug a Browser Scenario
prompt_templates.prompt: Use --pw on [URL] to reproduce [scenario]. Capture console, network, screenshot, and DOM evidence, then fix and rerun the scenario.
prompt_templates.scenario: Browser defect investigation with Playwright MCP

prompt_templates.title: Investigate a Boundary Regression
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate [bug] across [modules]. Check caller, API, data, and shared-state boundaries before applying a durable fix and running all available regression gates.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced debugging across module and contract boundaries

output_examples.input: The checkout page fails after an expired session is refreshed.
output_examples.output: Root cause: the refreshed session updates storage, but the checkout client retains the expired token. The fix refreshes client state before retrying.

output_examples.input: A profile form saves successfully but still displays the previous name.
output: Browser evidence shows a successful update response followed by a stale cached query.
The fix invalidates the profile query and the repeated scenario displays the new name.
Regression checks pass and temporary diagnostics are removed.

best_practices: Provide the exact error, reproduction steps, environment, and recent changes.
Review proposed diagnostic locations before running the affected application.
Inspect every final diff and confirm that temporary logs were removed.
anti_patterns: Do not use this workflow for feature development or general code review.
Do not run project scripts from an untrusted repository without inspection and confirmation.
Do not include passwords, tokens, personal data, or production records in diagnostic output.

faq.question: Which languages support temporary logging?
faq.answer: The defined formats cover JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, and Kotlin.

faq.question: Does the skill require Playwright?
faq.answer: No. The default workflow uses user-provided logs. Playwright MCP is required only for --pw browser mode.

faq.question: Will it change source files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can insert temporary logs, apply a focused fix, and remove its marked diagnostics.

faq.question: How does it protect sensitive data?
faq.answer: The workflow requires masking passwords, tokens, and personal data. It also forbids logging in environment and secrets files.

faq.question: How does it verify a fix?
faq.answer: It reruns the failing scenario and available project checks, such as tests, builds, linting, or type checks.

faq.question: What happens when the cause remains unclear?
faq.answer: It adds limited diagnostic rounds, requests more reproduction details, and stops after the configured retry limit.
